newsitem.title: UK: GDR REPORT-London umoved as India takes holiday.
newsitem.headline: GDR REPORT-London umoved as India takes holiday.

text.p: Indian global depositary receipts (GDRs) were little changed in London trading as the Bombay Stock Exchange took a second day's holiday for a religious festival. "Nothing happened, it is as simple as that," said a trader.
The HSBC James Capel Indian GDR index JCEAI closed up 0.11 points, 0.16 percent, at 69.18 points, with the premium over the local market at 13.07 percent.
Although the BSE was closed, India's National Stock Exchange 50 share index rose nine points to 971.
The Capel Korea GDR Index ended up 0.66 points, 0.98 percent, at 67.94, a premium of 26.37 percent over the local market.
The Korea Composite Index shed 0.12 points to provisionally close at 781.76.

The Capel Taiwan GDR Index ended down 0.02 points at 89.67, a premium of 3.87 percent over the local after the Taiwan Weighted Index fell 40.02 points or 0.61 percent at 6,478.44. -- David Chance, London Newsroom +44 171 542 5887
